review:
A western duel game built on DuelRows: VS symbols stretch sideways into wild rows (longer depending on the reel), stage a duel, and the winner's multiplier hits every win it touches.

Three FS symbols give 10 free spins with more VS symbols; four give 8 with a DuelSpin Bar that adds spins, VS symbols and nudges. Three Hot 100 symbols start a single spin that keeps nudging until 100 wins are paid. Rated 4/5, 15,000x max, with RTP versions of 96%, 94%, 92% and 86%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.00% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
